messages:
Renee: Heads-up: planning to publish product launch blog Thu 10am PT. Need owners: hero line, bench stat + 1-line methodology, production UI screenshot, top-of-post webinar signup (email prefill), HubSpot hidden fields + UTMs, legal quick-pass.

Marco: I'll do the screenshot and export 1200x630 + @2x. Which route to capture?

Sasha: I can take hero + bench wording. Will avoid absolutes and add method note. Two hero options shortly.

Priya: I'll set up HubSpot form with hidden fields: lead_source=blog_launch, product_interest=inference, orig_utm; will support email prefill via `?email=` and UTMs for A/B (`utm_content=cta_a|cta_b`).

DesignBot: Uploaded hero candidates: https://drive.redwood/marketing/hero_set_v5.png. Recommend 1200x630.

Ivan (Legal): Edit bench claim: change "cuts costs 60%" -> "internal tests show up to 60% reduction in per-token inference cost" + short methodology line. Avoid SLA claims.

Sasha: Done; pushed to /content/drafts/launch_post.md with method: "(10k request sample; 8xA100 baseline; end-to-end)".

Marco: Captured screenshots from staging, scrubbed PII, uploaded. :white_check_mark:

Priya: Form + hidden fields + UTMs wired, prefill tested, SFDC routing doc updated (company_size>=500 -> Enterprise). :white_check_mark:

Ivan (Legal): Reviewed and approved with bench caveat. :white_check_mark:

Renee: Great. Lock hero tomorrow AM and I'll schedule Thu 10am. React with :white_check_mark: when done.
